bounded_recommendation.alternative: If owner requires unchanged eligibility, stop at a truthful failed/partial Q4 result under current scope; a general PIT admission or mixed-deliverable runtime extension is outside no-code authorization.
bounded_recommendation.announcement_boundary: Use the actual notice publication time available for each rule; if only a date is known, conservatively apply after that session. Do not assume the exact Nov4 effective date or IBM1 deliverable was knowable from an earlier notice without checking its contents.
bounded_recommendation.approval_boundary: This is a new eligibility policy. Parent should obtain owner approval of the concrete rule/source scope before implementing it. No approval is inferred from the broad config-only rerun authorization.
bounded_recommendation.config_only_proposal_for_owner_review: Use existing source preparation/onboarding machinery to make a separately pinned market/context eligibility variant. Keep all212 symbols, model artifacts, three methods and economic settings. At each decision, exclude contracts only under a public action notice available before that decision and whose unsupported deliverable begins during their holding interval. Keep an explicit sidecar of every excluded symbol/date/expiry, policy reason, announcement timestamp, source notice and before/after counts. Rebind source/protocol identity as a new attempt; retain the original failed source/run.
bounded_recommendation.existing_positions: A pre-entry filter cannot repair holdings entered before the action became publicly known. Parent reports no selected IBM holdings before Oct12, but that observation is not the policy predicate. If another action affected already-open holdings, existing config lacks a general close/convert mechanism.
bounded_recommendation.immediate: Allow the already running final method and audit to finish; retain full attempt and explicit failed nominal_lp. Do not relaunch or call a successful-quarter publish/report helper on incomplete results.
bounded_recommendation.post_action_boundary: Do not exclude all IBM or all post-action decisions. Preserve positively identified standard IBM contracts after the effective date; unsupported IBM1 contracts remain refused. If current normalized quotes cannot distinguish the two, a date-only filter is not sufficient proof of supported instrument identity.
bounded_recommendation.uniformity: Apply the approved support policy consistently across all methods and affected instruments using predecision information, not only the realized losing/failed book.

independent_checks.result: Only fill_sizing is an optional study parameter. Pair schema is exactly id/symbol/dte_min/dte_max and must cover the exact symbol set. No decision-date, known_at, root/deliverable or holding-exclusions policy is accepted.

Pinned forecasts/contexts are filtered by symbol/DTE/fold/band and clocks. Context projection is identity plus spot/reference_scale/settlement_date. Corporate actions use only StandardSplitAdjustment.parse. No eligibility-policy role or exclusion reason enters the accepted MIO runtime.

Preparation passes only current-day basis to _prepare; fill checks next-session basis; settlement fails closed when active-position basis and observed expiry basis differ. The runtime does not support arbitrary composite underlying deliverables.

Exact same-root standard100-share integer split, ratio>1, equal strike divisor, fixed multiplier, and basis_after approximately basis_before*ratio. IBM-to-IBM1 with100IBM+20KD cannot truthfully be encoded here.

CDFQuoteCondorSelect.run compares entry basis against both next-fill and future-expiry factors and records basis_change. Weekly MIO calls _prepare, not this run method. Moving this guard into entry eligibility would use future realized basis; switching selectors also changes execution/accounting.

Other condor/calibration paths accept symbol/quote_date/expiry/reason exclusions. Their existence does not make them valid MIO input ports. No known_at enforcement is provided by these exclusion rows themselves.

Declares observed dividend/split-jump or symbol/date windows and excludes feature-through-settlement spans. It is a model-panel filter, not a point-in-time MIO contract-admission policy; it has no publication/known_at field.

Generic Filter supports declared clauses; Join supports declared lookup tables. They can support preparation of a separately pinned eligibility-filtered dataset. They do not infer corporate actions, enforce announcement chronology, convert existing holdings or create a MIO refusal audit. Such a source would be a new admission policy, not a configuration switch on the locked MIO method.
